diagnosis: In all four rollouts, the check C3 passed despite A3's PF2 fact not being accessible. This indicates that the model is assigning the generator pallet to Truck T-1 based on the 3,200-kilogram weight of the generator pallet exceeding the 2,500-kilogram limit of Truck T-3, which is a default behavior since the exact weight and limit were not provided to the lone decision-maker.

C3.why: The exact 2,500-kilogram limit on Truck T-3 versus the generator pallet's exact 3,200-kilogram weight changes the generator assignment to Truck T-1, leaves the administrative pallet on Truck T-3, and requires an axle-load verification commitment.
